description: ap.feedback(runRef, signals) normalisation against feedback-signals.schema.json: what becomes a window outcome, what is rejected and why. `accepted` is the call's return value. `runRef` pins the one token form (spool-format.md › Run reference): a token minted in either SDK parses in the other.

cases.name: thumbs up
cases.note: thumbs is stored as a boolean: up = true

cases.name: free text is refused
cases.note: unknown names never reach the spool

cases.name: mixed valid and invalid
cases.note: accepted when at least one signal is valid; the rest are named in rejected

cases.name: corrected value needs the slot enum
a runtime-only signal is refused from feedback
cases.note: goldenPass is written by the runtime's golden-set run (T34), never by ap.feedback(); custom cannot shadow it either

cases.name: custom cannot shadow a runtime-only signal

keys.name: a known secret, agent and target

tokens.name: no entries
tokens.note: a ref with no entries parses, and feedback on it returns false

tokens.name: eight worst-case entries
tokens.note: the largest ref a mint may write

tokens.name: 32 entries read
tokens.note: readers accept 32 entries; minting stops at 8

tokens.name: a fifth body element and unknown entry keys
tokens.note: both survive parse and re-mint, so a 1.0 host can grow a ref a later SDK wrote

rotation.name: a token minted under a previous key parses with that key listed

refused.name: a forged entry fails the MAC
